item.title: GB News Daily Reflection - Saturday 7th February 2026
item.description: In today’s Daily Reflection we explore the human instinct to cry out against unfairness, whether it’s pay gaps, big bonuses, or unearned inheritance. Jesus told a story of workers who labored different amounts but were all paid the same, challenging our sense of fairness. He asked, “Are you envious because I am generous?”showing that God’s generosity is not about what we deserve. Christianity teaches that God shares blessings freely, not because it’s fair, but because he is wonderfully kind.WATC
